body.query: What product version did Bloox launch in August 2026?

results.title: Bloox Launches AI CRM Marketing Agent 2.0 - The Asia Business Daily
results.author: Han Jinjoo
highlights:
On August 13, Bloox, an artificial intelligence (AI) marketing agent company, announced that it will unveil "Bloox 2.0," which allows the entire CRM (Customer Relationship Management) marketing process—from data analysis and planning to execution—to be managed within a single environment.
...
In November of last year, Bloox introduced "Bloox 1.0," the industry's first conversational AI CRM marketing agent. The Bloox agent enables even small marketing teams without developers or designers to carry out CRM marketing campaigns in a conversational setting, using both natural language prompt commands and click (selection)-based interfaces.
...
Whereas the previous version analyzed data through Q&A, providing charts and insights, version 2.0 fully automates the implementation stage of campaigns. Marketers can now focus on essential strategic decisions such as review and approval, rather than manual, complicated tasks.
...
The newly released 2.0 version completes complex marketing work within a single agent chat window, without the need to switch between multiple agents or platforms. The agent drafts and completes automated scenarios involving starting conditions, branches, and ending conditions. It directly handles everything from drafting Kakao notification talk templates to submitting them for approval. It autonomously creates promotional materials that fit the brand's tone and manner, regularly reviews campaigns at specified times, and suggests improvements.
...
Ji-Hyuk Lee, CEO of Blo
...
, said, "We are not stopping at being the first in the industry to introduce AI CRM agents; the advanced 2.0, based on real-world usage, has made autonomous operation from analysis to execution a practical reality for marketers. If Bloox 2.0 has demonstrated autonomy in campaign execution, our future 3.0 version will build the next-generation CRM environment by autonomously handling even performance prediction and optimization."

results.author: Duartttee
highlights:
‎Bloox - AI Audiobook Player App - App Store

# Bloox - AI Audiobook Player

Intelligent AI Audiobooking

Free · Designed for iPad. Not verified for macOS.

Share

iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch

Bloox is the most intelligent way to listen to audiobooks — a beautiful, private player that lets you read along word-by-word, chat with your story, catch up on anything you missed, and keep track of every character. Bring your whole library, listen anywhere, and pick up right where you left off. CHAT WITH YOUR STORY (Beta) Confused about a plot twist? Forgot how two characters are connected? Just ask. Bloox answers questions about what you've heard so far — grounded in the book, with no spoilers ahead. READ ALONG AS YOU LISTEN Bloox transcribes your audiobook in real time and follows along with synchronized captions — sentence by sentence or word by word, karaoke-style. Tap any line to jump straight to that moment, or switch to an immersive full-screen caption view. KNOW EVERY CHARACTER Lost track of who's who? See every character in the current chapter, with descriptions and chapter-by-chapter tracking — so you always know who just walked into the room. WHAT DID I MISS? Got distracted, or someone started talking to you? Get an instant AI recap of what happened — key events and a clear "where we are now," so you never have to rewind blindly again. Generated on-device — no internet, nothing leaves your phone. BOOKMARKS THAT REMEMBER Save a moment and Bloox saves the context with it — an AI snapshot of what was happening, so your bookmarks actually mean something later. PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF A home-screen widget shows a quick recap of where you stopped, so you're back in the story the second you press play. Smart rewind backs up automatically when you resume. BRING YOUR WHOLE LIBRARY Import from Audiobookshelf, Dropbox, your computer over Wi-Fi, Google Drive, iCloud, and local M4B/MP3 files. Automatic metadata and cover art included — and you can edit any detail yourself: title, author, narrator, series, or cover. SEE YOUR LISTENING Listening streaks, hours, session history, and per-session recaps — a beautiful picture of your reading life. CHAPTERS DONE RIGHT Reads embedded M4B chapters, CUE sheets, and multi-file books. No chapter data? Bloox generates smart chapters at the length you choose. BUILT FOR EVERY MOMENT Full CarPlay support for the road, Apple Watch controls on your wrist, and a gorgeous sleep timer designed for StandBy mode for bed. Adjustable speed (0.5×–3×), custom skip intervals, full chapter navigation, Lock Screen and Control Center controls, and hands-free control with Siri. PRIVATE BY DESIGN — AND YOU'RE IN CONTROL No account. No ads. No tracking. We never sell your data. The features that use the network — Book Chat and character lookup — are off by default: nothing is ever sent until you turn them on and explicitly say yes. Want total privacy? A single switch keeps everything — even anonymous analytics — on your device. Your library, your listening, and your choices stay yours. WORKS FULLY OFFLINE — AI INCLUDED No connection? No problem. Play, navigate, and read along anywhere — and your on-device AI keeps working too. Real-time transcription, "What Did I Miss?" recaps, and bookmark context all run right on your iPhone, online or off. Perfect for flights, commutes, and dead zones. MADE FOR iPhone & iPad A native app built with SwiftUI — fast, fluid, and equally at home on a phone on the go or an iPad on the nightstand. BEAUTIFUL, YOUR WAY A warm, focused design that's a genuine pleasure to look at — with full Light and Dark mode so Bloox looks right at any hour. Bloox. Your books, understood.

more

## What’s New

- Browse your library with new sorting, filters, metadata views, and search-aware results. Mark books finished or return them to listening, and replace cover art yourself. - Import from Dropbox, with resumable cloud downloads and more reliable account connections. Audiobookshelf is now out of beta. - Share book recommendations, export bookmarks as Markdown, and ask Siri to save a bookmark hands-free. - Last Moments and What Did I Miss? recaps now have a polished reading experience, clearer recovery when Apple Intelligence is unavailable, and optional quality feedback. - Playback is more dependable, including end-of-book recovery, chapter selection, speed-aware time remaining, and more reliable Lock Screen, Control Center, CarPlay, and widget behavior. - Captions now stay hidden when unavailable and can be turned off. Transcription navigation, multi-file chapter repair, and transcript preservation are also improved. - Accessibility, error messages, and stability have been improved throughout Bloox.

results.title: What Can You Do With an Audiobook Transcript? Apparently, You Can Talk to Your Book — Bloox
results.author: Elad Katz
highlights:
I built Book Chat, a new beta feature in Bloox that lets you ask questions about the audiobook you are currently listening to. It uses your heard-so-far transcript to answer questions about forgotten characters, confusing scenes, and the small details that tend to escape while you are walking, driving, or doing dishes.
...
The feature started as a very manual Claude Desktop experiment, went through a playground and several model providers, and now uses Gemini 2.5 Flash for answers. One important privacy note: Book Chat is optional, and unlike Bloox’s on-device transcription and recap features, your question and relevant book context are sent to Bloox servers when you use it.
...
I eventually landed on Gemini 2.5 Flash for the main answer path.
...
Bloox is free on the App Store. Book Chat is an optional beta feature for listeners who want a little help following the story.

highlights: So I built Audible import. You chose a book from your library, and Bloox added it to your device. It was US-only in v1 and handled one book at a time. Still, it changed the pitch from “this is useful if you already have files” to “try Bloox with the library you already own.” The direct import feature was later retired in Bloox 1.4.2.
